t: A pocket Meshtastic messenger with an e-paper screen, GPS, and a long-lasting battery.
steps: Buy the ThinkNode M1 from the Elecrow store. Pick the radio band for your country.
Screw the included antenna onto the RP-SMA port before you power it on.
Charge it with the included USB-C cable.
Install the Meshtastic app on your phone.
Pair the app with the M1 over Bluetooth and set your region.
Send a test message to a friend with a second node.
Update the firmware with the Meshtastic web flasher over USB.
Try the InkHUD screen layout in firmware 2.7 or later.
